title: Roadmap editing: open slicer tui for the project (needs adj 11)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: adj 11 option open-slicer-tui (open; recommendation "both"): ork suspends and opens `slicer tui --root P` for deep edits (adj 11 context). Bubble Tea's ExecProcess hands the terminal to another program and resumes after it exits. slicer's TUI is `tui` or `ui` (../slicer/docs/commands.md:91). The `--root` form is not yet checked against ../slicer/docs/tui.md.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/keys.go` (new key) and view.go (help line).
- `internal/tui/model.go` (the key returns a tea.ExecProcess command; on return, refresh the snapshot).
- `internal/tui/tui_test.go` and golden_test.go (help golden if the help changes).
- `docs/dashboard.md` (key list; Roadmap section).
- The ExecProcess signature: check with `go doc charm.land/bubbletea/v2 ExecProcess` in the worktree. Not verified here.
Open: adj 11 (ui.slicer-tui) decides whether this exists at all.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestOpenSlicerTuiReturnsExecProcessCommand: the key returns a command for `slicer tui --root P`.
- TestDashboardRefreshesAfterSlicerTuiExits: the callback fires and the snapshot reloads.
- TestMissingSlicerShowsErrorAndDoesNotPanic.
- The help view and docs/dashboard.md list the key.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests first (Failing tests). Run them and watch each fail for its stated reason.
2. Check `go doc charm.land/bubbletea/v2 ExecProcess` in the worktree, and `slicer tui --help` for the `--root` form (../slicer/docs/tui.md).
3. `internal/tui/keys.go`: an OpenSlicerTui binding on `O` (shift+o; proposed, `o` is free but `O` pairs with `P`). Active on the Roadmap view for the selected project.
4. `internal/tui/model.go`: the key returns `tea.ExecProcess` running `slicer tui --root PROJECT_PATH`; the callback returns a refresh message that reloads the snapshot. A missing slicer shows the error on the status line and does not panic.
5. `internal/tui/view.go` help line, `docs/dashboard.md` key list and Roadmap section.
6. Run go test ./internal/tui -update and review the golden diff.
Decided 2026-10-20: record 11 (ui.slicer-tui) is both: common edits in ork, one key opens slicer tui for the rest. The key (O) is proposed until the owner confirms it.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l . (prints nothing)
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner presses O on the Roadmap, edits in slicer tui, quits it, and finds ork back on the Roadmap with the change shown.
